Formula 1 has seen its fair share of shooting stars.
But with Andrea Kimi Antonelli, a star seems to be
rising that will shine brightly for more than just a
brief moment. Having first taken to the karting track
at the age of 7, his career really took off following
his European Karting Championship titles in 2020
and 2021. At just 15, he was racing for Prema in
Formula 4. As a Mercedes junior driver, he won the
German Formula 4 championship straight away in
2022 and the European FREC title the following
year. In 2024, he made a rapid leap straight into
Formula 2 and for 2025 joined the Mercedes AMG
Petronas Formula 1 works team replacing Lewis
Hamilton. Even the experts had to take a moment
to catch their breath.
G-spark
He took the number 12 from his childhood idol,
Ayrton Senna, who raced with it during his first
season with Lotus in 1985. It has been with him
since the start of his single-seater career. By the
end of the 2025 season, the youngster had already
secured his first podium finishes for Mercedes, but
even then, it was impossible to foresee the specta-
cular performance the young Italian would put on
this year. Shortly before his 20th birthday, he cur-
rently leads the F1 World Championship. His first
Grand Prix victory on 15 March 2026 at the Chine-
se Grand Prix in Shanghai was perhaps a milesto-
ne in Formula 1 history and may well have laid the
foundations for his first World Championship title.
